prompt: Look at the picture and choose the statement that best describes it.
promptZh: 請看圖片，選出最符合畫面的敘述。

options.text: A towel has been spread out on a bench.
options.zh: 有一條毛巾攤開在長椅上。
options.whyZh: 圖中的毛巾都垂掛在架上，沒有毛巾攤在長椅上。

options.text: Two towels are hanging from a rack.
options.zh: 有兩條毛巾掛在架子上。
options.whyZh: 兩條不同顏色的毛巾都垂掛在獨立架的橫桿上。

options.text: Two locker doors have been left open.
options.zh: 有兩扇置物櫃的門沒關。
options.whyZh: 置物櫃的門都是關著的。

options.text: A basket has been placed under the rack.
options.zh: 有個籃子放在架子下面。
options.whyZh: 晾衣架正下方沒有籃子。

explanationZh: 兩條不同顏色的毛巾都垂掛在獨立架的橫桿上。
evidence: Two towels are hanging from a rack.

vocabulary.note: Two towels are hanging from a rack.
